_comment: TEMPLATE (not a prototype): election result (certified state result) -- v2, no keyless wire API
claim: Candidate A is certified the winner of the 2026 US Senate election in State S by the state's chief election official on or before 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z.

elements.q: Do the exhibits show the State S chief election official's certified results listing Candidate A as the winner of the 2026 US Senate race, certified on or before 2026-12-31T00:00:00Z?

custom_definitions: Only the certified result from the state's chief election official counts; media calls and projections do not (unless MEDIA_CONSENSUS_CALL_V1 is adopted, which this sheet does not).
Recounts and contests: the result certified at the evidence cutoff controls; a pending contest at the cutoff makes the element insufficient (VOID after the cap), never NO.
The AP Elections API needs a paid key and state pages differ per state; each state needs its own pinned URL pattern checked at creation (D-FETCH1).
Burden of proof is on YES: an unproven or ambiguous element resolves NO.
Early resolution: YES may be declared at the first qualifying event; NO only at/after the deadline.
Fallback: a blocked, rate-limited or unreachable source is COULDNT_CHECK (never NO); the recovery ladder and the listed fallback source apply, then VOID.

sources_allowed.publisher: State S Secretary of State results page
